easyPrerequisites: Lagrella must be exiled by Yannik, and Worldgorger Dragon must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Worldgorger Dragon for its mana cost.
When Worldgorger Dragon enters, it exiles Yannik until Worldgorger Dragon leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Worldgorger Dragon's ETB.
When Yannik leaves the battlefield, Lagrella is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Lagrella enters, it exiles Worldgorger Dragon until Lagrella leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Lagrella's ETB.
When Worldgorger Dragon leaves the battlefield, Yannik is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Yannik enters, it exiles Lagrella until Yannik leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Yannik's ETB.
When Lagrella leaves the battlefield, Worldgorger Dragon is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
